**About The Company

**Founded in 2019, Novutech is a dynamic digital transformation partner with a team of over 60 consultants across Europe. We specialize in finance-focused digital transformation projects for international scale-ups and mid-sized enterprises. Our expertise lies in leveraging a core tech stack and the experience from hundreds of successful projects. We are committed to designing, delivering, and supporting end-to-end solutions that drive growth and efficiency.

**About The Role

**As a Senior Business Consultant, you will play a key role in delivering impactful digital transformation projects for our clients. Leveraging your NetSuite expertise, you will lead complex implementations, oversee advanced configurations, and act as a trusted advisor. You will also mentor junior consultants and progressively develop your people management skills, with the opportunity to lead your own team in the future.

• Lead and execute end-to-end NetSuite implementation projects, from requirements gathering to go-live and post-implementation support.

• Oversee advanced NetSuite configurations and customizations to meet customer needs, acting as a Subject Matter Expert.

• Configure, customize, and optimize NetSuite modules according to client needs.

• Monitor, test, validate, and resolve advanced problems in NetSuite areas.

• Maintain and document high-level processes and complex customizations for external stakeholders.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing best practices and recommendations.

• Support change management and user adoption initiatives.

• Manage overall relationships as Customer Success Manager for medium to large customers, handling tickets, organizing calls, and ensuring quality.

• Contribute to project planning, scoping, and estimation activities, collaborating with internal teams and stakeholders to ensure project success.

• Participate in sales and presales activities as an expert.

• Mentor and supervise business and tech analysts, providing guidance, feedback, and supporting their development through activities such as regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career growth planning, while ensuring high standards in methodology and consulting practices.

• Act as the right hand of the Manager or Director, upholding company values and amplifying leadership messages.

• Contribute to internal projects fostering innovation and growth through entrepreneurial ideas and OKRs.

• Stay updated on NetSuite developments and actively share knowledge with the team.

Why joining Novutech?

• Be part of a fast-growing company with a startup spirit, and enjoy a friendly environment with tremendous colleagues and a hybrid work setup.

• Experience a place where you can grow, learn, and make a significant impact.

• Benefit from a good work-life balance, fostering both personal and professional well-being.

• Enjoy international exposure by collaborating closely with colleagues across our global offices, enriching your professional experience and broadening your cultural understanding.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in NetSuite consulting, implementation, or administration.

• Proven track record of successful NetSuite implementations and advanced configuration.

• Strong understanding of business processes (Finance, Accounting, Operations, etc.).

• Experience working in a consulting environment or with multiple clients.

• Demonstrated experience in mentoring, coaching, or supervising junior team members.

• Customer Success Management experience is a plus.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to build strong client relationships.

• Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with attention to detail.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative, international team.

• Entrepreneurial spirit and drive for continuous improvement.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of French or Dutch is a plus.

• Willingness to travel occasionally within Europe as required.

If you are excited about the opportunity to make a difference and grow with us, we want to hear from you! Join Novutech and be part of an adventure that’s shaping the future of digital transformation.

General Manager - Denmark

This is a rare chance to step into a country leadership role where your impact will be visible from day one.

You'll inherit a business with strong operational foundations and talented people already in place. The opportunity now is to strengthen commercial performance, build greater accountability, accelerate growth and establish Denmark as a leading performer within Northern Europe.

If you're energised by transformation, growth and creating lasting business success, we'd like to hear from you.

• Driving revenue growth, profitability and market share.

• Leading and developing commercial and operational teams.

• Building stronger sales capability and commercial discipline.

• Strengthening key customer relationships.

• Leading the continued integration of CamVision.

• Creating alignment, accountability and business performance across the Danish organisation.

Your background will likely include:

• Experience as a General Manager, Managing Director, Country Manager or Business Unit Director.

• Ownership of a significant P&L with responsibility for business performance.

• A proven track record of driving revenue growth and leading commercial teams.

• Experience leading service-led, installation, project-based or field operations businesses.

• Success in improving business performance within a changing or challenging environment.

• The ability to engage, motivate and develop diverse teams.

• Experience operating within a regional, international or matrix organisation.

Sector Experience We Value

We're particularly interested in leaders from:

• Security Integration

• Electronic Security

• Fire & Security

• Smart Buildings

• Building Technologies

• Technical Services

• Engineering Services

• Other project and service-led technology environments

Why Securitas Technology?

At Securitas Technology, you'll join a global leader with a clear purpose: helping make the world a safer place.

This role offers the opportunity to:

• Shape the future of our Danish business.

• Lead with real autonomy and influence.

• Drive a high-profile business integration programme.

• Contribute to the wider Northern Europe leadership agenda.

• Build a lasting legacy within one of the world's most recognised security and technology brands.

Before You Apply

This opportunity is best suited to leaders who combine commercial leadership, P&L ownership and operational management experience.

Ready to make a lasting impact? We'd love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship in cerebral interoception at Center for Translational Neuromedicine
jobs.description:
We are offering a PhD fellowship in cerebral interoception commencing 15 February 2027 or after agreement.

  Our group and research
 Center for Translational Neuromedicine focuses on developing new approaches for examining and treating neurological diseases, primarily using the tools of physiology and imaging coupled with cell and gene therapy. Our emphasis is on using these technologies to enable neural and glial cell replacement in the adult brain and spinal cord, as a means of both disease modeling and therapeutic repair.

  Center for Translational Neuromedicine currently has 55 employees and students and is divided into five labs. CTN is characterized by a highly ambitious research environment. The Center is highly interdisciplinary and has many international collaborators. The PhD-student will be part of the Kaag Rasmussen lab, Division of Pain Volume Transmission. Being part of the Kaag Rasmussen lab offers an opportunity to work in an in vivo lab engaged in the neuroscience of pain signalling, focusing on transgenic animal models, behaviour, in vivo imaging and omics technologies. 

  Project description
 In this PhD project we will characterize the functional and molecular characteristics of meningeal sensory neurons. In all the body, different sensory neuron classes project to various targets and are fine-tuned at a functional and molecular level to detect and transmit sensory information from the target organ to the central nervous system. The sensory neurons projecting to dura mater and pia mater have been known to play a role in headache pathology, yet very little is known regarding their functional and molecular properties. This PhD project will dissect out which sensory neuron subtypes project to dura and pia mater, what stimuli they respond to, and define their molecular identity. The aim is to identify what subclasses of meningeal sensory projection neurons are involved in headache experience, and to identify new molecular targets within these sensory neurons that could provide basis for headache therapeutics in the future. To achieve this we will use a combination of in vivo imaging of transgene animals expressing various fluorophores that be used as indicators of neuronal activity and single cell transcriptomics.

  Principal supervisor is Martin Kaag Rasmussen, Center for Translational Neuromedicine, martin.rasmussen@sund.ku.dk.

  Start: 15 February 2027 or after agreement

  Duration: 3 years as a PhD student

  Job description
 Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:

   	
• Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.    	
• Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points. 	
• Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team. 	
• Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project 	
• Teaching and disseminating your knowledge. 	
• Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project   PhD Programme Description
 The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., Neuroscience).

  Qualifications
 If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).

  If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.

  As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.

  Other important criteria are:

   	
• The grade point average achieved 	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Previous publications 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other professional activities 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in pain and headache as well as basic neuroscience 	
• Language skills   Place of employment
 The place of employment is at the Center for Translational Neuromedicine, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and state-of-the-art equipment

  Terms of employment 
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is 15 February 2027 or after agreement.

  The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant. The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. 

  Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 31,800 DKK/Roughly 4,250 EUR (August 2026 level) plus pension.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website.

  Application procedure
 Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format: 

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)

  2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

  3. Certified copy of degree diploma(s) relevant to a Danish master’s or bachelor’s degree depending on whether you completed your education in Denmark or abroad (read more under Qualifications). If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science.

  4. Publication list (if possible)

  Application deadline: 17 November 2026, 23.59 CET

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.

  The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.

  Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You find information about the recruitment process here.

  The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in PHA Processing and Modification by Reactive Extrusion - DTU Chemical Engineering
jobs.description:
If you are excited by doing reactive extrusion, online monitoring and materials characterization for renewable polymer systems such as PHAs, this could be the PhD project for you.

Responsibilities and qualifications
The objective of this PhD project is to develop next-generation polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA) compounds through advanced polymer processing, formulation, and reactive extrusion. The project will focus on improving processability and performance while establishing relationships between formulation, processing history, polymer structure, and final material properties. 

As a PhD student, you will prepare and process new PHA formulations using extrusion-based methods, investigate reactive processing and novel additive concepts, and evaluate compounds for injection moulding, extrusion, and blow moulding. You will combine offline polymer characterization with online and in-line analytical methods to monitor changes during processing and support adaptive control of composition and process conditions. 

We are therefore looking for candidates with: 

• Practical experience in polymer processing, preferably extrusion or reactive extrusion, obtained through MSc studies or equivalent research activities. 
• A strong interest in biopolymers (natural polymers), polymer formulation, compounding, and structure-property-processing relationships. 
• Hands-on experience with polymer characterization, particularly FTIR, rheology, DSC, TGA, and NMR. 
• Experience with Raman spectroscopy, online analysis, or process monitoring, which will be considered an advantage. 
• Experience with injection moulding, film or profile extrusion, or blow moulding, which will be considered an advantage. 
• The ability to plan experimental work independently and collaborate effectively across polymer chemistry, processing, and analytical disciplines. 
• An interest in teaching and supervising student projects as part of the PhD programme. 
The project is expected to generate new knowledge on the processing and stabilization of PHA-based materials and to deliver high-performance compounds designed for safe handling, demanding processing routes, and environmentally benign end-of-life scenarios. 

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applications will be conducted immediately after the deadline, and we expect to call for interviews in November.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Anders E. Daugaard, adt@kt.dtu.dk. 

You can read more about DTU Chemical engineering at www.kt.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)

 The Department of Immunology and Microbiology at University of Copenhagen is a unique interdisciplinary research flagship exploring the biology of pathogenic microbes and our immune system, with the aim of improving population health.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and accomplished Postdoc scientist to work at the intersection of theory, simulation, and data analysis in black hole astrophysics for a four-year position, commencing on 1 March 2027.

  Information about the Department can be found at: The Niels Bohr International Academy – University of Copenhagen

  Your job

  The Assistant Professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regard to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Assistant professorship. To a limited extent this may also include performance of other duties

  Specifically, the chosen applicant is required to work on the following problems

  1) Are extragalactic jets seen throughout the Universe really powered by black hole spin energy and can we prove it with polarimetric observations?

  2) How do gravity, radiation, and high-energy particles interact to determine the structure and dynamics of accretion disks and the jet launching region around low luminosity AGN?

  3) What is the best way to use sparse and noisy observations from Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) arrays to precisely measure the properties of black holes and their astrophysical environments?

  Profile

  We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following competencies:

  Essential experience and skills:

  In order to pursue these questions, the chosen candidate must have a substantial record of leadership in the global Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) collaboration as well as a role in the project team for the proposed NASA Black Hole Explorer (BHEX) mission.

  The chosen candidate must have a proven track record in the analysis of VLBI data, running and interpreting General Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamic (GRMHD) simulations, and building semi-analytic models of black hole accretion and jet launching for comparison with extremely high-resolution EHT data. This position is for four years.

   

  Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. Who you are

Minds and makers forging ahead together.

A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.

jobs.description:
Does it excite you to shape digital products and AI-enabled solutions that make regulatory data flow reliably across the enterprise and on to EMA and FDA, and do you have experience with Veeva Vault RIM? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

**Your new position

**As Associate Digital Product Director – Regulatory Data & AI, you will drive the evolution of our digital products, enterprise systems and data capabilities, with a primary focus on Regulatory Affairs and Medical Writing and opportunities across the wider organization. A key responsibility is the continued development of regulatory data capabilities in Veeva Vault RIM and other connected Vaults, ensuring that product hierarchies and master data are structured consistently and flow reliably across systems and to health authorities. You will act as business owner of regulatory data, working in close partnership with Digital, Data & Technology (DD&T’s) Data Analytics & AI Platforms team. As our pipeline advances towards late-stage submissions and our digital transformation accelerates, you will build the foundations for connected, data-driven and increasingly AI-enabled business processes that are built on trusted data and responsible AI practices.

**We Offer Exciting Responsibilities

**

• Drive digital product strategy and roadmaps aligned with Zealand’s enterprise data and AI strategy, translating business needs into prioritized initiatives that deliver measurable value

• Own the product hierarchy and regulatory master data in Veeva Vault RIM as business data owner, ensuring clear stewardship, accuracy, completeness and consistency across the organization

• Connect business-critical regulatory data across Veeva RIM, eTMF and Safety Vaults and, together with DD&T, make it available to enterprise platforms and data lakes, in alignment with regulatory data standards (IDMP, SPOR, xEVMPD, eCTD v4.0), GxP and data integrity requirements for EMA and FDA

• Explore and assess generative AI, AI agents, intelligent automation and advanced analytics, and turn promising opportunities into practical solutions for Regulatory Affairs and Medical Writing, through governed AI delivery, together with DD&T and business teams

• Define and own regulatory data products, APIs, reporting and business intelligence solutions, built on the shared enterprise data platform with DD&T, that make information more accessible, actionable and reusable across functions

• Lead system evolution and cross-functional transformation initiatives, including those supporting Medical Writing, from evaluating new releases and capabilities to implementation, validation, change management and post-launch optimization

**Your profile

**You are a digitally minded product professional who combines business understanding, systems thinking and technological curiosity. You understand the importance of regulatory data and the processes it supports, and you look beyond individual systems to see opportunities across the wider digital ecosystem. You work independently, bring structure to complex initiatives and build trusted relationships across business and technology teams. You are comfortable owning data in the business and you are curious about how AI, automation and modern data platforms can transform the way we work, and you help colleagues build confidence in new ways of working.

• Extensive experience in digital product management, business systems or technology transformation, ideally within pharmaceutical, biotech or another regulated industry

• Solid understanding of Regulatory Affairs and the product development lifecycle, including CTAs/INDs, eCTD, submissions and lifecycle management

• Experience with complex business applications, data models, master data and cross-system integrations; hands-on experience with Veeva Vault RIM is important, and experience with eTMF or Safety Vaults is an advantage

• Ability to define product vision, prioritize competing needs and align business, IT, data and external partners around shared outcomes

• Familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, data lakes, business intelligence and tools such as Vault Loader, as well as data governance, data ownership and data product concepts, and an interest in generative AI and intelligent automation

• Proven ability to lead complex initiatives independently, including integrations, release management in GxP-validated environments, adoption and change management

**Your new team
